test: migration dry run protects RLS, permanent worker binding, idempotent publication and stale screening
actual_checks: Entire saved migration executes against minimal questions/passage_groups schema and anon/authenticated/service_role roles
A second worker cannot claim the permanent ledger binding even after lease expiry
Single publication retries do not duplicate inventory
Passage group failure rolls back both parent and children
Complete passage group retry is idempotent
Screening import rejects changed key and parent passage snapshots
Question dispute atomically records reviewed content version and applies a hold
Authenticated role cannot read factory jobs or execute worker claim RPC
Pilot defaults to 800 and rejects unbalanced target 101
limitations: Minimal SQL fixture is not the complete linked Supabase schema
Real foreign keys, existing schema types, service-role API/RLS, storage and authenticated repair/import flows need staging proof
Application verifies evidence HMAC; service-role SQL fixture signatures are intentionally software-only
AGENTS.md requires staging evidence and explicit approval before production migration
